text:
Tessa: Heads-up — Invoice COP-2026-091 (Copperline) is 45 days overdue. ACH returned 2026-03-02 (code:R01). Outstanding balance: $92,400. Need decision: structured plan or start escalation.
Omar: Copperline says cashflow timing issue due to delayed funding. They propose 4 equal installments over 90 days and want a one-time partial late-fee forgiveness (50%).
Kelly: They've been a steady customer for 3 years; product usage steady. I support a workaround but want firm controls.
Ravi: We should insist on an irrevocable ACH mandate and clause that any missed payment triggers immediate suspension + collections referral. Also ask for a company guarantee from parent if available.
Tessa: Quick invoice snapshot:
```
Invoice: COP-2026-091
Amount: $92,400
Issued: 2026-01-20
Due: 2026-02-15
Return: ACH R01 on 2026-03-02
```
Proposal (recommended): 4 installments of $23,100 due on 2026-04-01, 2026-05-01, 2026-06-01, 2026-07-01. Waive 50% of late fees upfront only if the signed ACH mandate + payment guarantee are received by 2026-03-25 and first installment clears on 2026-04-01. Provisioning: restrict API key creation and pause non-critical background jobs until first payment clears.
Omar: Copperline will accept the schedule but requests a short acknowledgement to sign. They want the late fee reduction documented.
Kelly: Fine with conditional 50% waiver but require Legal-Bot to generate a one-paragraph MOU that includes default remedies and referral to collections. No credit exceptions beyond this.
Legal-Bot: Draft MOU template ready — will attach 1-page MOU stating payment schedule, conditions for fee waiver, ACH authorization requirement, and remedies on default.
Ravi: Approve with the guarantee clause if parent company info is provided. If not, make the waiver contingent on first two payments instead of first payment.
Tessa: I'll send the draft to Omar to get Copperline sign-off. Collections-bot, please set reminders and escalation triggers.
collections-bot: Action created: set reminder 7 days before each installment, escalate to collections if payment not posted within 5 business days after due date. Automated dunning emails scheduled starting 2026-03-24.
